meta.pdf_font: IYECGW+NotoSansDevanagari-Regular (xref 1343), Type0 Identity-H, 967 glyph slots, 254 non-empty outlines
meta.outline_check: all 254 non-empty embedded glyphs have the same contour points, end points and advance width as the same glyph id in the reference font (fontTools); 2.002 and 2.007 releases have 954/845 glyphs and do not match
meta.method: each used glyph id is identified by shaping the reference font with HarfBuzz (uharfbuzz) on 187,394 generated clusters (consonants ± nukta with every vowel sign and ं ँ ः, all 2-consonant conjuncts with every vowel sign, ्र/्य/्व clusters, all 3-consonant conjuncts, reph forms of all of these, independent vowels, digits, punctuation); "evidence" lists the shortest inputs that produce the glyph. The value/role assignment is then checked by decoding every survey string back from its glyphs
meta.roles: base: spacing cluster glyph; half: pre-base half form; pre: pre-base ि variant (written after its cluster), possibly carrying ं/ँ and/or reph; post: mark after the base, possibly carrying reph; reph: र् drawn after its syllable (written before it); dummy: no text; dotted: shaper-inserted U+25CC, no text
meta.unmapped: none: every glyph id that occurs in the PDF (251) is produced by the shaping survey; no glyph needed to be settled by eye

134.name: uni25CC
134.how: U+25CC: HarfBuzz inserts it before a mark/reph without a base, e.g. 'र्इ' → [uni25CC, rephdeva, ideva]

652.name: dummymarkdeva
652.how: zero-width placeholder emitted after a combined ि+ं/ँ/reph glyph, e.g. 'किं' → [ivowelsignanusvara03, ka, dummymark]
